adapter_on_observed.incomplete_reason: lab wall-clock bound reached during episode

infrastructure_findings.finding: Experiment 1 commits its report only after the entire recurrence sweep returns, so a deadline during any episode discards all completed tasks and cells.
The preregistered battery requires 72 tasks times four recurrence depths before factorial ablations, but all experiments share one 60-minute deadline.
The deadline begins before checkpoint and adapter load, while report.started_at is recorded after load, so available evaluation time and reported elapsed time use different boundaries.
There is no per-task or per-cell append-only result, idempotency key, deterministic resume cursor, or completed-cell manifest.
Experiment 1 was invoked without its equal-compute vanilla baseline; the requested factorial experiment contains a vanilla arm but cannot run if Experiment 1 exhausts the shared deadline.

required_before_replacement_preregistrat: append-only task-level outcome records bound to checkpoint, adapter, task, arm, seed, config, and verifier version
atomic resumable cell manifests with duplicate refusal and complete-cell validation
separate model-load, warmup, per-episode, per-cell, and campaign deadlines
preflight runtime estimate proving the requested battery fits the campaign bound
separate immutable experiment jobs rather than one shared deadline for Experiment 1 and factorial ablations
paired adapter-on and adapter-off manifests with identical external task roots and task ordering
strong matched-compute vanilla controls in the same claim-producing experiment
blinded scoring, contamination checks, regression suites, repeated seeds, and independent certificate verification
live installed-app resident-32B activation and rollback proof after offline gain is established
replacement_run_policy: Do not rescore or selectively rerun the failed arm. Repair the harness, publish a new preregistration before execution, retain this void artifact, and rerun both arms from the same immutable task roots.
